label: FS AP-N505 (Wi-Fi 6 indoor AP, 2.5G combo SFP)
description: FS AP-N505 - dual-radio Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) indoor AP, 2x2 on 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz, up to 3 Gbps aggregate. 1x 1G RJ45 with 802.3af PoE-in (12.95 W max), 1x 2.5GE combo SFP (accepts 1G copper or 1G SFP), 1x RJ45 console.
notes: Vendor figures from the FS AP-N505 datasheet: **1 x 10/100/1000Base-T RJ45 with PoE-in, 1 x 2.5GE combo SFP port** ("10/100/1000Base-T electrical port, conformity to 1GE SFP") and a **1 x RJ45 console port**. Datasheet power line: **802.3af, 12.95 W max consumption** - it also lists 802.3at and 802.3bt with the same 12.95 W figure, which is the ceiling, not the draw. The combo cage is the interesting part: it takes either a copper 1G module or a 1G SFP, so one AP can be fed by fibre without a media converter - and it is 2.5G-capable, so the wired side is faster than the 1G port next to it. Dual power: DC barrel preferred when both DC and PoE are present. Supports up to 256 clients and 32 ESSIDs; fat/fit mode detection is automatic.
